title: English Practice Quiz 0974
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: To 'prioritise' tasks means to ___.
questions.explanation: Prioritising ranks tasks so important work receives attention first.

questions.question: A realistic schedule should include ___.
options: time for tasks and short breaks
more work than the day allows
questions.explanation: A realistic plan accounts for both work and recovery time.

questions.question: If two urgent tasks conflict, you should ___.
options: confirm which task has higher priority with the supervisor
questions.explanation: A supervisor can clarify competing priorities.

questions.question: The phrase 'ahead of schedule' means ___.
questions.explanation: Ahead of schedule means progress is faster than planned.

questions.question: A task that is 'overdue' ___.
questions.explanation: Overdue describes something not completed by its due date.

questions.question: Breaking a large project into smaller steps can make it ___.
questions.explanation: Smaller steps make progress clearer and more manageable.

questions.question: Which habit helps prevent missed appointments?
questions.explanation: Calendar reminders provide a prompt before an appointment.

questions.question: A 'buffer' in a schedule is extra time allowed for ___.
questions.explanation: A buffer helps absorb delays or unexpected work.

questions.question: When a deadline changes, you should ___.
options: update the plan and inform affected people
questions.explanation: Updating the plan helps everyone work to the same deadline.

questions.question: The best way to track a recurring task is to ___.
options: set a regular reminder or checklist
record it only after a year
questions.explanation: A recurring reminder or checklist supports consistency.
